reasoning_content:
The capacitor project needs the capacitor-android local project to be included to compile. This is too complex to setup manually. Let me take a different approach - the simplest would be to just copy the web build into a WebView and manually create a minimal build. 

Actually, the easiest path forward here is to use GitHub Actions since it has all the tooling ready. Let me just commit what we have and push to GitHub to trigger the workflow.

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Use simple wrapper from standard template
c.exec_command("""curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nicowitt/nicowitt.github.io/main/gradlew -o /opt/areloria/client/android/gradlew
chmod +x /opt/areloria/client/android/gradlew
ls -la /opt/areloria/client/android/""")

# Also get gradle wrapper properties
c.exec_command("""mkdir -p /opt/areloria/client/android/gradle/wrapper
curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nicowitt/nicowitt.github.io/main/gradle-wrapper.properties -o /opt/areloria/client/android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties""")

c.close()
EOF
